name: gpu-vllm-mi300x-2b
description: Claude Code plugin for the MI300X Gemma 4 rig: one management skill and one MCP server, both named after the rig directory. Only matters if this rig is published standalone — the marketplace /plugin reads is the monorepo root one.

plugins.name: gpu-vllm-mi300x-2b
plugins.description: One AMD Instinct MI300X (gfx942, 191.69 GiB) serving google/gemma-4-E2B-it through vLLM on a DigitalOcean GPU droplet reached via AMD Developer Cloud. Droplet lifecycle, rocm-smi diagnostics that do not trust an exit code, image vetting that catches the vendor build which cannot load Gemma 4, and text/thinking/tool-calling/vision verification against the live endpoint.
